scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only 2, 3, or 4 lowest normalized-Laplacian path modes, a single vertex, exactly m consecutive observations, an injective spectral multiplier on those modes, and determinant optimality. The complete motivating preprint could not be materially inspected; historical priority is uncertain. Finite numerical checks are supplementary to the analytic proof.
title: Sharp low-pass D-optimal sensor migration on normalized paths through four modes
